# Upstream arithmetic generation

The expression sampler in the study adapts the signed-operand, random-split and parenthesis logic of the Reasoning Gym contributors' basic arithmetic generator. Division, global negation, formatting selection and its final expression evaluation are omitted. The study adds canonical IDs, intermediate-node labels and transfer partitions. [Pinned source](https://github.com/open-thought/reasoning-gym/blob/5aea50d292a6427f12c63c77873ec8ae945cd2c0/reasoning_gym/arithmetic/basic_arithmetic.py) · [Apache License 2.0](LICENSE)
